title: Operations Human Resources Partner Intern (6 Months) - 2027
description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Power that runs the world \| Discover careers in Operations Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You’ll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You’ll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real\-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn’t abstract, it’s visible, immediate, and meaningful \- keeping one of the world’s most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions. Key job responsibilities * Developing in\-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazon's fast\-paced operations * Assisting with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries, promoting collaboration and information\-sharing * Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth * Learning about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and staying up\-to\-date on best practices * Providing support to Amazon employees on a range of daily queries related to attendance, engagement, compensation, and other HR matters * Assisting HR teams with day\-to\-day operational routines and administrative tasks * Participating in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation, driving efficiency improvements * Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision\-making * Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities A day in the life Every day is a little different as an Operations Human Resources Partner Intern. This internship will immerse you in HR within a global organisation, with the opportunity to work on projects across different HR areas — from employee relations and training to compensation and workforce analytics. You might spend your morning analysing workforce data to identify trends and build recommendations for your team, then spend your afternoon supporting an employee relations case or collaborating with operations leaders on a training initiative. Amazon's HR function is deeply embedded in the business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve using data and analytical thinking to drive decisions. You'll apply your problem\-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands\-on experience. With a dedicated mentor guiding your development throughout the programme, you'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organisational excellence — providing a strong foundation for a career in human resources. Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date. About the team Intern Community: As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests. Support: The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive. Learning Sessions: Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry\-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career. Opportunities: Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits. Internship Start Dates across the year: We are hiring interns to start anytime from January through September 2027\. Each month, we'll hold 1\-2 onboarding days for new hires. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above * Currently in your penultimate or final year and working towards a university bachelor’s or master’s in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, Marketing, Social Sciences, Law or a related field (Humanities focused), or a similar discipline * Available for a full\-time internship (40 hours/week) and able to commit to a 6\-month internship **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process improvements and innovative solutions. * Excellent communication and teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with others. * Demonstrated curiosity, proactivity, and willingness to take on challenges in an ambiguous, fast\-paced environment. title: Software Development Engineer - Elasticache, AWS ElastiCache
description: **Description** Build the next\-generation in\-memory database services! AWS ElastiCache, a fully\-managed in\-memory data store compatible with Valkey, Redis OSS, and Memcached, enables customers to build data\-intensive apps or boost existing database performance by retrieving data from high throughput and low latency in\-memory data stores. AWS MemoryDB, a Valkey and Redis OSS compatible, durable, in\-memory database service, delivers ultra\-fast performance for modern, micro services applications. The AWS In\-Memory Databases team uses ideas from several facets of computer science – data storage, distributed computing, and more – to help customers build low latency and fast performance NoSQL systems. Our high availability and scalable in\-memory distributed services are powered by open source and optimized for sub\-millisecond latency at scale. We are influencing the direction of NoSQL systems throughout the industry – and we want you to be a part of it. We are seeking motivated, passionate backend engineers to work with in\-memory database technologies including Valkey, Redis OSS and Memcached and make AWS ElastiCache the best place to run these engines. You will use your analytical, design, and problem\-solving skills to build next\-generation technologies in areas of horizontal and vertical scaling, data replication, data sharding and migration algorithms as well as robust authentication/authorization protocols. As part of this role you will work closely with Valkey OSS community to influence and contribute net new features as well as performance optimizations to open\-source Valkey. Our team understands and values work life balance. Most days, our entire team is co\-located in the Dublin office, but support occasional remote work if needed. We generally keep core in\-office hours from 10am to 4pm and provide flexibility for people to structure their working hours around them. The role involves day time on\-call responsibilities, typically once every 2\-3 months. We don’t like to get paged in the middle of the night or on weekends; so we investigate operational gaps on a weekly basis, proactively root\-cause issues and fix them for good. Our team has a mixture of engineers from diverse backgrounds and tenures. We are dedicated to supporting new team members through on\-boarding buddies and mentorship. We try to assign projects based on each team member’s unique background and provide them opportunities to learn new skills to make them better rounded engineers. We celebrate knowledge sharing and encourage each member to participate and learn through team wide design reviews. Our team is intentional in building a daily work environment where mutual respect, equity and positive recognition of differences are cultivated. We seek diverse perspectives in our team meetings and respect honest feedback to help us make effective decisions. Elastic Cache is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. **About The Team** Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience programming with at least one software programming language * Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems * Knowledge of system performance, memory management, and parallel computing principles **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations * Experience programming with C, C\+\+ or Rust Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates. Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. **Company** \- Amazon Development Centre Ireland Limited Job ID: A10528166

title: Software Engineer II
description: **Overview** Windows \+ Devices (W\+D) is hiring Software Engineers in Dublin across two teams that share a commitment to making Windows a trusted, intelligent, and reliable platform for customers, enterprises, and partners worldwide. The **Modern AI Trust platform engineering team** is transforming what trust means to Microsoft and our customers. The team builds innovative, AI\-driven solutions that enable product agility, enterprise\-scale automation, intelligent decision systems, trustworthy development, and responsible AI use. As a frontier organization developing solutions for the next generation of Windows, the team is focused on retaining and strengthening the trust of our customers and partners. The **Windows Silicon \& Systems Integration (WSSI) Compat team** plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices and silicon, from Arm\-based laptops to gaming consoles. The team maintains the health of the Windows application ecosystem, ensuring that every Windows release remains compatible with the broad range of applications customers depend on. Its work spans in\-market and new hardware across multiple form factors, silicon vendors, and customer segments, while supporting the continued evolution of Windows for new devices and AI capabilities. As a Software Engineer in W\+D, your work will contribute to Windows experiences used by more than one billion people and influence engineering teams around the world. Depending on your team placement, you may build AI\-powered platforms and automation that strengthen trust across the Windows development lifecycle, or deliver solutions that detect and prevent critical application compatibility issues before they reach customers. Across both teams, you will tackle complex engineering problems, use AI and large\-scale data to generate insights, guide engineering decisions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of Windows. **This Opportunity Will Allow You To** * Play a fundamental role in defining and building products used by millions of people. * Develop innovative AI\-powered solutions and help shape the next generation of Windows. * Solve complex engineering challenges using large\-scale data and cutting\-edge technologies. * Work with a high degree of autonomy and have strategic input into what the team delivers. * Collaborate with engineering teams across Microsoft and deliver impact on a global scale. * Invest in your professional development through continuous learning, on\-the\-job experience, and in\-person and online training, including Microsoft’s monthly learning day. * Work in a modern environment as part of a team that values results, flexibility, inclusion, and enjoyment. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** We’re looking for an experienced **Software Engineer II** to join the Windows and Devices organization. In this role, the ideal candidate will design, implement, ship engineering and data products that transform how Windows is built and shipped. The ideal candidate will forge partnerships and collaborate with others across the engineering and product/program management disciplines within W\+D. Finally, as a member of the team, the candidate will have the opportunity to drive scenarios and influence technical direction across teams, mentor less experienced engineers, and contribute to building and maintaining a culture and environment that engenders continuous learning and open collaboration. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND professional technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python * OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements** : Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: **Microsoft Cloud Background Check** : This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications** * Relevant industry software design and development experience working with a major programming/scripting language (C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python). * Strong design, debugging and problem\-solving skills. * Strong interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to influence outcomes and communicate technical content to general audiences . * Experience of leveraging the latest AI technologies in real\-world software solutions. * Ability to resolve ambiguities effectively, prioritize and drive projects to completion, prioritize between multiple needs and adapt to changing circumstances. * Demonstrated history of promoting engineering excellence within a team; design for reliability, testing, measurement, and understanding of the complete software lifecycle. * Attention to detail; passion for great design. * Obsession for great end user experiences and outcomes. * Ability to grow and maintain organizational and interpersonal relationships. \#W\+DJOBS \#IrelandWSSIJobs \#Windows \#AI \#Frontier Software Engineering IC3 \- The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 63,400\.00 \- € 105,700\.00 per year. title: Structural Engineer
description: **Job Description** At Boylan Consulting, we are seeking a Structural Engineer to join our multidisciplinary engineering and environmental consultancy team. This is a varied technical and client\-facing role supporting structural engineering projects from concept and detailed design through technical coordination and completion. The successful candidate will work across residential, commercial, industrial and modular projects, providing practical and technically robust solutions. We are looking for a professional with 4\-6 years of relevant experience, including experience within the Irish engineering and construction industry. The candidate should be able to work independently, manage projects and deadlines, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and communicate confidently with clients and contractors. Experience in modular construction or Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) is desirable. **At Boylan Consulting, we offer:** 1\) Continuing Professional Development 2\) Competitive salary 3\) A friendly working environment **About the available position:** • **Location:** Unit 33, Kells Business Park, Kells, Co. Meath, A82 Y466 • **Salary:** Negotiable • **Education:** Structural Engineering degree • **Experience:** 4\-6 years • **Work Arrangement:** Primarily Office\-based position **Key Responsibilities \& Duties:** The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of technical and project activities, including: • Undertaking structural design for residential, commercial, industrial and modular projects. • Preparing structural calculations, drawings, specifications and technical reports. • Designing steel, reinforced concrete, timber and masonry structures. • Coordinating structural information with architects, civil engineers, fire consultants, building\-services consultants, manufacturers and contractors. • Supporting modular construction and MMC projects, including structural interfaces, connections, foundations and compliance requirements. • Attending office\-based client, design\-team and coordination meetings, including online meetings where appropriate. • Responding to construction\-stage queries and providing technical support through project completion. • Managing assigned programmes, deliverables and client requirements. • Reviewing drawings and calculations prepared by junior engineers and technicians. **Essential Requirements:** • 4\-6 years of structural engineering experience, including relevant Irish industry experience. • Experience designing steel, reinforced concrete, timber and masonry structures. • Ability to prepare and review structural calculations, drawings, specifications and reports. • Working knowledge of Irish Building Regulations, Eurocodes and relevant engineering standards. • Experience using Tekla Structural Designer, TEDDS or similar structural analysis and design software. • Experience using AutoCAD and familiarity with Revit. • Strong technical judgement, communication and problem\-solving skills. • Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently within a multidisciplinary team. **Desirable Skills / Attributes:** • Experience in modular construction, off\-site construction or MMC. • Experience with BIM and Revit coordination. • Knowledge of structural connections, foundation interfaces and transportation or lifting considerations for modular units. • Progress toward Chartered Engineer status with Engineers Ireland or another recognised professional body. • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage office\-based design and coordination activities.
